evals.prompt: I need a testing suite for my new project. It's a TypeScript API using Bun. I have some time-sensitive logic for token expiration.
evals.expected_output: The agent should perform a discovery and audit, then ask deep interrogation questions, specifically addressing the time-sensitive logic and potential use of setSystemTime.
expectations: The agent lists files to discover existing tests and configuration.
The agent asks about the primary goal (TDD, coverage, migration).
The agent mentions setSystemTime or faking timers for the token expiration logic.
The agent does NOT write any test code in the first turn.

evals.prompt: Migrate my current Jest tests to Bun. I have a lot of mocks and I want to make sure they still work. We also use snapshots extensively.
evals.expected_output: The agent should audit the existing Jest configuration and tests, then ask about specific mocking needs, snapshots, and performance constraints.
expectations: The agent searches for jest.config.js or package.json with jest config.
The agent mentions Bun's mock.module and snapshot update command.
The agent mentions using --update-snapshots for the migration.
The agent does NOT start the migration in the first turn.

evals.prompt: I have 50% coverage, help me get to 80% with Bun. The project is a React app. We need to test the components properly.
evals.expected_output: The agent should audit the current coverage report, then ask about important areas to cover and UI testing preferences, specifically recommending happy-dom.
expectations: The agent looks for existing coverage reports or test files.
The agent asks about the preferred UI testing setup and recommends happy-dom + preload.
The agent mentions adding /// <reference lib="dom" /> for TypeScript support.
The agent does NOT add new tests in the first turn.
